items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-09-08
items.q: Boyd Reed, anything, he was a sight... they could play though oh yeah they could excuse man this shit could do something they felt as Reed couldn't play like him

ctx.x: Boyd Reed, anything, he was a sight. The band used to come, man we had such a good sight reading band till the band used to come from the hotel there. Used to come from the Roseville Hotel and different hotels and come there and bring music. And fast they'd give it to us, they'd throw it up there, we used to play. We were sight readers, you know. What does Fulet play?
What different instruments? Saxophone and clannin. Both, huh?
